results.primary_cause: No verifiable external evidence was found confirming or contradicting the exact specialty DRAM, NOR, or NAND pricing and utilization driver; pricing, demand, and utilization breadth remain unresolved.
No verifiable external evidence was found confirming or contradicting the exact commodity DRAM ASP, bit-demand, and inventory cycle; HBM evidence cannot be used as a substitute.
No verifiable external evidence was found confirming or contradicting the exact memory IC design-demand and ASP cycle.

Evidence supports evolving SSD and NAND-controller demand at a company-specific level, but the available evidence does not establish a time-consistent industry-wide NAND pricing, controller/module demand, and inventory cycle; contradictory breadth and inventory evidence remain insufficient.

supporting_evidence.claim: Phison Electronics is refining NAND flash controller and storage solutions as data growth and SSD adoption reshape demand across consumer devices and data centers.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Phison Electronics Corp highlights its NAND controller role as demand for storage keeps evolving

results.primary_cause: Evidence indicates stronger dry-bulk freight conditions and Capesize demand, but BIMCO-related reporting warns that apparent 2026 strength may be substantially driven by temporary rerouting and could reverse into a 2027 supply glut; the exact underlying commodity-volume freight cycle is therefore conflicting.

supporting_evidence.claim: A key measure of dry-bulk shipping rates reached its highest level since December 2023, driven by rising Capesize demand and tightening vessel supply for bulk commodities.
supporting_evidence.source_title: Dry-Bulk Shipping Rates Hit Two-Year High on Capesize Demand

supporting_evidence.claim: The Baltic Dry Index reached 2,732 points on July 31, 2026, increasing approximately 9.2% during July, with conditions differing across dry-bulk segments.
supporting_evidence.source_title: HTCO Highlights Strengthening Dry Bulk Market as BDI Rises Approximately 9.2% in July and Shipping Equities Gain Investor Attention

counter_evidence.claim: BIMCO warned that apparent 2026 dry-bulk market strength was substantially artificial because of forced rerouting and that the temporary boost could reverse into a 2027 supply glut.
counter_evidence.source_title: Dry bulk shipping faces 2027 supply glut: BIMCO warns Hormuz rerouting boost will reverse
